azimuth_convention: three.js equirect (RGBELoader, EquirectangularReflectionMapping, no rotation): u = atan2(dir.z, dir.x)/(2*pi) + 0.5, so azimuth_deg_threejs = (u-0.5)*360 measured from +X toward +Z; dir_threejs is the unit vector to the sun/glow. If scene.backgroundRotation/environmentRotation rotates the sky by yaw r about Y, rotate dir_threejs by the same r.
